question: Corals are marine invertebrates within the class Anthozoa of the phylum__________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cnidaria**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Corals are marine invertebrates within the class **Anthozoa** of the phylum **Cnidaria**.
 
• Cnidarians are characterized by the presence of specialized cells known as **cnidocytes** that they use mainly for capturing prey.
 
• The phylum **Cnidaria** includes not only corals but also jellyfish, sea anemones, and hydra.
 
• Corals primarily form **symbiotic relationships** with algae called zooxanthellae, which provide them with energy through photosynthesis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phylum Cnidaria**

 
 
• Cnidaria is a phylum under the kingdom Animalia that includes around 10,000 species of aquatic animals.
 
• They are predominantly marine species but also include freshwater species.
 
• Cnidarians have a simple body plan with radial symmetry, a mouth, and tentacles.
 
• They exhibit two main forms: the polyp (e.g., sea anemones) and the medusa (e.g., jellyfish).
 
 
 
• **Anthozoa**
 
 
• Anthozoa is a class within the phylum Cnidaria that includes corals, sea anemones, and sea pens.
 
• They are exclusively marine animals.
 
• Unlike other cnidarians, anthozoans do not have a medusa stage in their life cycle.
 
• They are often colonial and can form extensive coral reefs which provide critical habitats for marine life.
 
 
 
• **Zooxanthellae**
 
 
• Zooxanthellae are a type of symbiotic algae that live within the tissues of corals.
 
• They perform photosynthesis and provide the coral with organic compounds, which serve as a major energy source for corals.
 
• This symbiotic relationship is essential for the growth and health of coral reefs.
 
• Coral bleaching occurs when corals expel their zooxanthellae due to stress conditions such as increased sea temperatures.
 
 
 
• **Cnidocytes**
 
 
• Cnidocytes are specialized cells unique to the phylum Cnidaria.
 
• They contain organelles called nematocysts, which can deliver a sting to capture prey or for defense.
 
• These cells play a crucial role in the feeding mechanism of cnidarians.
 
• The venom delivered by cnidocytes can vary from mild to extremely potent, depending on the species.
